coverage.title: Fresh food, across the Kingdom
coverage.body: Daily delivery in these cities and the areas around them — with more added every month.

cities.q: Which cities do you deliver to?
cities.a: We deliver daily across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam and the surrounding major areas, with new cities added regularly.

pause.q: Can I pause or skip a day?
pause.a: Yes. Skipping a day releases that day’s allowance and extends your plan by one day, so you never lose a meal you paid for.

change.a: Open your plan, tap the day, and swap a dish for another meal in the same week. Each dish can be swapped once, up to its cutoff.

fresh.q: How is the food kept fresh?
fresh.a: Every meal is prepared the same morning and delivered in insulated, eco-friendly packaging within hours of cooking.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: All major cards and local payment methods. The full amount is shown before you confirm — no hidden fees.
